verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a GenAI DDQ feature: a product demo article and a guide titled 'How to Use the Autofill Automation for Questionnaires', listed in the May 2024 release notes. That indicates AI autofill for security/due-diligence questionnaires exists, but the evidence consists only of article titles with no detail on how answers are generated. Missing for 10: evidence that answers draw on the customer's own controls and knowledge base, a documented draft-review/approval workflow, details on supported questionnaire formats, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
